title: Cross-Border Trafficking: From Detection to Interdiction
summary: End-to-end border intelligence is equipping agencies, teams and taskforces with a unified view of border security threats to help prevent and mitigate cross border trafficking, crime and terror for safer borders.
body_markdown:
In this **[Federal News Network](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/federal-insights/2026/02/cross-border-trafficking-from-detection-to-interdiction/)** article, Brian Gilkey covers how today’s Fusion Centers support human trafficking interdiction, counterterrorism, transnational crime detection, narcotics and weapons smuggling analysis and much more. These facilities comprise a critical layer of U.S. homeland security architecture for border and interior threat detection, bridging the gap between[strategic intelligence and field operations](https://www.cognyte.com/blog/border-security-data-fusion/) in an increasingly complex security environment.


Read the article **[here](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/federal-insights/2026/02/cross-border-trafficking-from-detection-to-interdiction/)** .


Published February 2026.
